structurePatterns: horizontal flex: leading | content (grows) | metadata + trailing
content stacks title over description with 2px internal gap
actionable shows chevron disclosure; selectable shows check
divider between items is inset to content start (12px), handled by Divider
usageHints: title single-line ellipsis by default; description max two lines
at most three information levels before restructuring
whole-row action must not overlap trailing action hit areas
doNotInvent: no default shadow on list item
unknowns: leading avatar/icon exact background pairing derived from Avatar component
